causalDefect.description: Onboarding used check-then-insert around the unique SaaSIdempotencyRecords(EmpresaId, IdempotencyKey) key. Two concurrent requests can both observe no ledger row, then one insert loses with DbUpdateException instead of deterministically replaying the winner for identical payload or returning conflict for a different payload.
causalDefect.requiredRecovery: Catch only the unique-key collision, rollback/clear failed tracked inserts, reread the winner ledger record, replay if normalized payload matches, otherwise return deterministic conflict; add directed concurrency/recovery tests and rerun causal BACKEND_API gates.
